activity_subtitle: Look back through the pages and tick each one you spot.
question_templates: How do you think {character} felt at the end of {title}?
What was your favourite part of {title}, and why?
If you could spend a day with {character} and {character2}, what would you do together?
Which picture in {title} would you most like to step inside?
What would you do if you were in this story?
